title: Orchestration of ML workloads via Cloud Composer & GKE Kueue

blocks.html: Our presentation demonstrates efficient ML workload orchestration using Cloud Composer (managed Airflow) and GKE Kueue. After brief introductions to GKE Kueue and Cloud Composer, it dives into a practical example: LoRA FineTuning of Gemma models. This ML workflow, implemented as an Airflow DAG, includes benchmarking and uploading results to VertexAI. A step-by-step guide and recorded demo complete the presentation, offering a comprehensive understanding of the process.
